trello.name: Configure Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Owner: Alex (Team Lead) / Developer. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Set up three subscription tiers in Stripe: Basic ($29/mo, basic AI access, limited features), Pro ($49/mo, additional features, priority support), and Enterprise ($99/mo, all features, custom support, integration options). Ensure these tiers are correctly reflected in the app for functionality and user experience.

trello.name: Update Pricing Page UI
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Update the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers. Design requirements: Clean and straightforward layout, clear comparison of features for each tier, prominent checkout button, and a tooltip/help icon explaining plan change consequences. Ensure the design matches the app's overall aesthetic.

trello.name: Implement Frontend Checkout with Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Implement checkout using Stripe Elements. Ensure the form is customizable, secure, and matches the app's design. Handle potential errors gracefully (e.g., invalid card details, insufficient funds) with clear user notifications. Coordinate with Taylor for API integration.

trello.name: Develop User Dashboard Subscription Features
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Build the user dashboard to display current plan details and billing info. Include functionality for users to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions, access invoices and payment history, and update payment methods. Ensure real-time reflection of subscription status and notify users of changes (upgrades, payment failures).

trello.name: Integrate Backend Stripe API
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Integrate Stripe’s API to handle subscription tasks: creating subscriptions upon payment completion, processing successful and failed payments, and managing webhooks. Ensure the backend correctly updates the system based on API responses.

trello.name: Implement Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: Within 2 weeks. Set up handlers for specific webhook events: invoice.payment_succeeded (activate/continue subscription), invoice.payment_failed (notify user, prompt payment update, send email), and customer.subscription.deleted (update access rights, offer re-subscription). Test handlers thoroughly to ensure correct system updates.

trello.name: Create and Execute Test Plan
trello.desc: Owner: Taylor (Lead) / Jordan & Taylor (Execution). Deadline: Week 3 (after initial integration). Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests. Simulate scenarios including payment failures, cancellations, and the full subscription flow from sign-up to billing. Ensure all edge cases are covered and functionality is as expected.

trello.name: Develop User Documentation and Support Materials
trello.desc: Owner: Jordan & Taylor. Deadline: Before launch. Create a help section/FAQ covering common subscription issues and questions. Document API endpoints and webhook event handlers for maintenance and troubleshooting. Provide clear instructions for users on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling issues.

trello.name: Schedule Follow-up Meeting
trello.desc: Owner: Alex. Deadline: Next week. Schedule a follow-up meeting to review progress, address blockers, and coordinate frontend-backend alignment. Ensure any issues encountered during development are discussed and resolved.
